title: The DINAMO Cup – clean sport from the border line!
body_html:
The General Inspectorate of the Border Police has launched table tennis competitions within the institutions of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Moldova and, on 21 March, organised under the auspices of the National Sports Association ATTP the DINAMO Cup 2025 tournament for border police officers.

The competition took place at the TOP CUP Academy arena in Chișinău and brought together the best table tennis players from all Border Police subdivisions.

The tournament was played in both singles and team formats, which made it possible to identify the strongest players as well as the best-coordinated teams.

The organisers prepared a full competition programme that included qualifying matches, semi-finals and finals. The participants showed excellent paddle technique, fast reactions and great stamina. The winners were awarded diplomas, medals and cups.

The DINAMO Cup table tennis tournament is creating fine traditions that will help build team spirit and develop sporting values among law-enforcement staff. The organisers invite everyone interested to support the players and to take part in future events under the auspices of ATTP.

This year there are plans to expand the competitions and attract an even larger number of players from other institutions of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Moldova.
